project_type: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Supabase + TailwindCSS 4 (no tailwind.config.js)
build_system: Vite 6.2.3, npm workspaces - TailwindCSS 4 uses @theme block in src/index.css only
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to compile. 2. Run npm run lint to check TypeScript. 3. Run npm run dev and manually test on mobile viewport (DevTools mobile emulation at 375px width). 4. Test admin page navigation and forms with large touch targets. 5. Verify logo displays correctly. 6. Test all page navigation via mobile nav.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder contents (build artifacts). These are gitignored and regenerated on each build. Never commit them.
environment_constraints: TailwindCSS 4 does NOT use tailwind.config.js - all theme customization goes in src/index.css @theme block. Vite config at vite.config.ts. Logo is at e:\Freelancing\zppssrpf\assets\logo.png and must be imported as relative import from components (Vite static asset handling). No react-router - app uses custom useState-based routing in App.tsx.
contribution_requirements: No formal AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found in project root. Follow existing code patterns: functional components with TypeScript, props interfaces, lucide-react icons, TailwindCSS utility classes matching existing @theme tokens.
key_patterns: 1. Custom routing: currentRoute state in App.tsx, navigate function passed as prop. 2. Context providers: AuthProvider and DataProvider wrap entire app. 3. Color tokens: use --color-primary (#000666), --color-secondary-container (#ff8f00), --color-surface, etc from @theme. 4. Typography: font-headline-lg, font-body-md, text-headline-lg classes map to custom font tokens. 5. Icon usage: import from lucide-react, use w-6 h-6 sizing. 6. Forms: use rounded-lg, border-outline-variant, focus:border-primary, bg-surface-bright on inputs. 7. Cards: bg-surface-container-lowest, border border-outline-variant, rounded-xl, shadow-sm. 8. Buttons: bg-primary text-white or bg-secondary-container, rounded-lg, hover states, cursor-pointer class required.
directory_structure: Root: package.json, vite.config.ts. src/: main.tsx (entry), App.tsx (root component with routing), index.css (@theme), components/ (Header, Footer, ImageUpload, ToastContainer), pages/ (Home, Admin, Admission, Achievements, Facilities, Contact), context/ (DataContext, AuthContext), hooks/ (useToast), lib/ (supabase, imageUpload). assets/: logo.png (exists, needs to be imported). public/: static assets served by Vite. No src/components/ui/ folder yet - will be created for shadcn-style components.
